title: Check the target of NewType.
summary: The target of a :pytyping.NewType definition must be a class type. It can't be a union type, Any, or various other special types. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check validity of types.
summary: Mypy checks that each type annotation and any expression that represents a type is a valid type. Examples of valid types include classes, union types, callable types, type aliases, and literal types. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Require annotation if variable type is unclear.
summary: In some cases mypy can't infer the type of a variable without an explicit annotation. Mypy treats this as an error. mypy enables this error code by default.
